conviction_note: Nothing decisive was found. This is the first print after the June 2026 deal to sell Satellite & Space to Gilat. The common is a thin residual (about $38m market cap) under roughly $109m of post-sale debt and a $220.5m preferred liquidation preference. Liquidity facts lean positive: revolver undrawn, $10m prepaid, five straight positive OCF quarters. The Allerium bookings drought and the likely discontinued-ops and impairment presentation lean negative. abs_move is set at the name's 18.1% median reaction because there is no usable option chain, turnover is thin and a first standalone-Allerium framing is likely. p_up is 47: the evidence is balanced, and the 6-of-7 negative reaction history nudges it below 50. The scaled -1.08 and the findings sum of -0.8 agree in sign and size.
bar: Q4 FY26 (quarter ended 2026-07-31) consolidated revenue of about $109-114m and adjusted EPS of about -$0.23 to -$0.51. Revenue sources roughly agree: Benzinga (June 17) $113.51m / -$0.23, https://cdn2.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/movers/26/06/53255414/why-comtech-telecommunications-shares-are-falling-on-wednesday; Earnings Whispers $109.3m / -$0.35, https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/CMTL; Stocktwits $111.65m / -$0.51, https://stocktwits.com/symbol/CMTL/earnings. The EPS estimates disagree. The company gives no guidance ('has not provided future Non-GAAP financial guidance'), per the Q3 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/23197/000002319726000070/fy26q3ex991earningsrelease.htm. Q3 actual was $106.0m against a $110.2m estimate. The bar is partly sourced and the EPS bar is disputed, so findings that depend on it are capped small. If S&S is reported as discontinued operations, the headline revenue will not be comparable to this bar.
positioning_check: Short interest is 422,928 shares, 1.43% of float, about 1.0 day to cover, at the 2026-06-30 settlement (Benzinga https://it.benzinga.com/quote/CMTL/short-interest; CurvedTrading, FINRA, https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/cmtl/). That is not crowded, but it is stale: no September 2026 settlement was found. There is no usable option chain: the ATM legs are not two-sided, there is no skew, put/call OI is 0.3 on 1,103 contracts total. Tape: spot $1.27, -14.8% over 20 days, -78.8% from the 52-week high, +7.6% above the 52-week low. Average volume is about 269k shares a day, roughly $0.34m turnover. The stock fell from $2.66-2.99 on 2026-06-17 to $1.68 on 2026-07-31 to $1.27 now. Reaction history: 6 of 7 prints negative, median |move| 18.1%.

findings.finding: The Allerium segment's Q3 book-to-bill was 0.32x, against 0.91x a year earlier. The CFO put it down to 'timing of large multiyear contract awards' and management said it was 'pretty bullish' on recompetes. Searches found no Allerium award press release between April and October 2026, although the company did PR its Oklahoma (March 25) and Kentucky (April 8) milestones. So nothing public shows the Q4 bookings catch-up the company implied.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the last print (2026-06-15), the 0.32x Allerium book-to-bill was a flagged weak line and the stock fell 42.86%, though the Gilat sale terms landed the same day, so the cause is mixed.
findings.why_not_priced: Segment bookings are disclosed only in the release. If the market expected a strong Q4 Allerium rebound, the stock would not be making new lows (-14.8% over 20 days). The absence of award PRs is weak evidence, because multiyear renewals with wireless carriers are often not announced.
findings.independence: The Q3 release confirms 0.32x and gives no Allerium dollar bookings (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/23197/000002319726000070/fy26q3ex991earningsrelease.htm); that is the same underlying number. The absence of awards rests on searches, not a document. The Oklahoma statewide ESInet/NGCS contract SW1170M, awarded 2026-09-10, does not name its vendor (https://oklahoma.gov/content/dam/ok/en/omes/documents/sw1170m-new-contract-UA.pdf), so it points neither way.

findings.finding: Liquidity is better than the price implies. The revolver was repaid in May 2026 and was still undrawn on 2026-08-03. On 2026-07-31 the company made voluntary prepayments of $6.5m senior and $3.5m subordinated, plus $1.0m of scheduled principal, and lenders waived the FY26 excess-cash-flow prepayment. Q3 operating cash flow was +$6.1m, the fifth straight positive quarter. Liquidity was $49.4m at April 30.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The June print reported its fifth straight positive OCF quarter and the stock still fell 42.86%. Cash quality has not been rewarded on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The 8-K is public but read by few on a $38m name. A market that had absorbed it would not be trading the common like a going-concern stub at 7.6% above the 52-week low. The prepayments were partly funded by Gilat's $10m advance, which limits what they say about operating cash.
findings.independence: The Q3 release gives OCF of $6.1m and liquidity of $49.4m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/23197/000002319726000070/fy26q3ex991earningsrelease.htm). The 10-Q states the sources of liquidity are sufficient for the next year and carries no substantial-doubt language (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000023197/000002319726000069/cmtl-20260430.htm).

findings.finding: The common is a residual behind about $109m of post-sale debt and a $220.5m preferred liquidation preference. Senior debt was $116.0m and subordinated $104.8m plus a $32.5m make-whole at 2026-06-12, and expected net sale proceeds are $143-145m. Management's pro forma Allerium EBITDA is $34m, including $12m of savings. The subordinated make-whole drops to 50% only if repaid before 2027-04-01, so the print's recapitalisation or refinancing plan is a line that could move the stub either way.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The June 15 announcement of the sale and recap terms (preferred exchanged into B-4, repurchase deferred to 2029) coincided with -42.86%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock trades at about $38m of equity because of this stack. What is not priced is the specific recap path (new senior term loan, preferred terms), which management said would follow. Covenant arithmetic is inference, so this is sized small with a wide band. Financing question answered: the sale money buys debt reduction, not growth. The residual risk is the preferred, which accrues and is senior.
findings.independence: The Q3 release gives the debt and preferred figures (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/23197/000002319726000070/fy26q3ex991earningsrelease.htm). Same capital-structure documents as the liquidity finding but a different question (the size of the claims ahead of the common versus near-term cash).

findings.finding: The Q4 presentation is likely to differ from the bar. The Q3 10-Q says held-for-sale criteria were 'not met as of April 30, 2026'; the sale was signed June 14 and should be probable by July 31. If S&S becomes held for sale or discontinued operations at FY-end, continuing-ops revenue would be roughly Allerium's ~$56m against a ~$110m consolidated consensus. The annual test also lands against $204.6m of goodwill on a $38m market cap, which risks a GAAP impairment or loss on the held-for-sale remeasurement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior discontinued-ops print. FY25 included a $79.6m impairment of long-lived assets including goodwill (per the 10-Q comparison), and the stock reaction to that period's prints was negative.
findings.why_not_priced: Aggregator consensus ($109-114m) is still on a consolidated basis, which suggests nobody has re-based estimates. Automated headlines could print a large 'miss'. An informed holder would look through it, so the size is small. The impairment is unquantified and non-cash.
findings.independence: none. This is an inference from accounting rules applied to the 10-Q language and the June 8-K signing date.

findings.finding: Gilat said on 2026-08-05 that the Comtech acquisition is 'progressing well' and 'anticipated to close toward year-end'. HSR and CFIUS clearance had not been reported publicly by 2026-10-14. The print is the first company update on regulatory progress since June.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Deal terms in June coincided with -42.86%. No prior print carried a deal-progress update.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market were confident of closing, the residual equity would not be pricing near-distress. A confirmed HSR expiry or CFIUS filing acceptance would de-risk the deleveraging. The counter-risk is a delay past calendar 2026, and a 2020 Gilat-Comtech deal was terminated. Net small positive.
findings.independence: The Comtech June release said the deal was expected to close in calendar Q4 2026 (https://satellitemarkets.com/latest-developments/comtech-announces-definitive-agreement-sell-most-its-satellite-and-space-communications-business-gilat). Same deal, different party.

findings.finding: The company is reporting FY26 on 2026-10-14, about four weeks earlier than FY25, whose results and 10-K came on 2025-11-10. That lowers the risk of a late 10-K or new going-concern language accompanying the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY25 print on 2025-11-10 moved +7.0%, the only positive reaction in the last seven.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a timing signal that nobody aggregates. It is an inference, sized small.
findings.independence: The 2026-10-05 8-K cites the FY25 10-K as filed 2025-11-10 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/23197/000002319726000088/exhibit991-pressreleasexco.htm).

findings.finding: On 2026-10-05 Comtech appointed Christopher Maloney as an independent director, effective 2026-10-01. Maloney founded TriTech, a 911/public-safety software company sold to Bain in 2018. The release frames the strategy as 'sharpening its focus on public safety' after the S&S sale, which could precede an Allerium standalone framing or strategic optionality on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no history of governance items moving this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock fell after the appointment, so no optionality is being priced. This is a soft signal and sized small.

findings.finding: Insider filings since June do not show conviction buying. The Form 4 checked (Daniel Gizinski, President of S&S, filed 2026-10-01) shows only RSU vesting of 8,893 shares with 4,011 withheld for tax at $1.37. The other three 2026-10-01 Form 4s share a vest date and were not opened.
findings.why_not_priced: Absence of insider buying at $1.3 is weak evidence and only partly verified, so it is sized near zero.

outside_window.finding: Closing of the Gilat purchase of S&S ($157.5m; HSR and CFIUS pending), guided by both parties to calendar year-end 2026. Gilat's own Q3 report (likely November) would carry the next third-party update.
The subordinated-loan lender warrants (625,000 shares at $0.10) vest 2026-10-17 unless the closing-date term loans are repaid first, a small dilution after the window.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The findings are near-balanced and slightly negative, in line with the -14.8% 20-day drift and the 6-of-7 negative reaction history. Nothing found argues strongly against the drift, and nothing adds to it beyond what the price already shows.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction; 6 of 7 prints sold): liquidity finding cut from +1.0 to +0.7 and deal-progress finding from +0.5 to +0.4, because positive cash facts were not rewarded in June.

Lesson 2 (unquantified reported-quarter impairment): discontinued-ops/impairment finding kept under reported_quarter but cut from -1.0 to -0.8, because it is an inference rather than a quantified document number.
Lesson 6 (bar disputed on EPS, revenue roughly agreed): bar-dependent findings (Allerium bookings, presentation) left capped small; no change beyond the item above.
Lesson 7 (short interest checked before negatives): 1.43% of float, 1 day to cover, not crowded; negatives left as sized.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the capital-structure finding answered that the sale money buys debt reduction and the preferred overhang remains; sign kept small negative.
